lead_raw_text:
The structure of AlAu2Co crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Al centers with 8 Au neighbors, while Au centers have 11 neighbors (4 Al, 6 Au, 1 Co) and Co centers have 8 Au neighbors, all described as a single three-dimensional geometric neighbor component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and face sharing between Au 11-vertex polyhedra and between Au and Co 8-vertex polyhedra, plus edge sharing between Au 11-vertex polyhedra. The theoretical density is not supplied here.
